why: The black part grows by one-eighth of the circle (45 degrees) in each step: A has 1/8, B has 2/8, D has 4/8 and E has 5/8. So the missing figure C must have 3/8 of the circle black. Option 1 has about 3/8 black, so it fits. Option 5 is half black, which is the size for D, not C.
trick: Count how much of the circle is shaded in each figure; the shaded part usually grows by the same amount each step.
note: The exact start and end positions of the black parts do not follow a clean rotation; the size rule (45 degrees more each step) is the clearest rule.
